title: Too Many Games: My Games Dialog
description: When creating a game is refused with HTTP 429 too_many_games, the create screen now opens a dialog listing the caller's own unfinished games (short id, lobby or in progress, players, age) with Open and Terminate, an inline 'Really end this game?' confirm, 'Terminate all my games', and a Create game button that retries the original request once a game has been ended. A game this browser holds no seat token for shows 'Not yours (other browser)' and has no Terminate button. Synthetic: the real create screen against a mocked server answering like the real one, regenerated by npm run screenshots -- DA.

shots.heading: Desktop: the list
shots.caption: Three unfinished games. The third was made from another browser: no Terminate, labelled honestly. Create game is disabled until something is ended.

shots.heading: Desktop: confirm
shots.caption: Terminate asks 'Really end this game?' inline with Yes / No.

shots.heading: Desktop: after terminating
shots.caption: Two games ended and gone from the list; Create game is enabled and retries the original create.

shots.heading: Phone: the list
shots.caption: 390x844, the dialog stays inside the screen with no sideways scroll.

shots.heading: Phone: confirm
shots.caption: Yes / No buttons at least 40 px tall.

shots.heading: Phone: after terminating
shots.caption: Only the other-browser game remains; Create game is enabled.
